summary: Contestants will answer objective questions to demonstrate their foundational knowledge of management and entrepreneurship concepts, including business planning, marketing, finance, and strategic decision-making. The event is open to any secondary or postsecondary division contestant and is completed within sixty minutes. No reference materials or AI tools are allowed during the test.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
competencies: Demonstrate understanding of entrepreneurship principles, including business plan development, startup requirements, feasibility analysis, and the characteristics of successful entrepreneurs
Demonstrate understanding of management and human resource concepts, including planning, organizing, leadership, staffing, motivation, and workplace policies
Analyze small business strategies by evaluating financial data, marketing plans, operational decisions, and short - and long-term planning approaches
Demonstrate understanding of core marketing concepts, including research, segmentation, value creation, pricing, and promotion
Apply financial literacy skills including interpreting basic financial statements, understanding startup costs, budgeting, and evaluating business performance metrics
Understand legal, ethical, and socially responsible business practices, including regulatory compliance, business ownership structures, and professional conduct standards
Apply strategic decision -making and problem -solving skills to evaluate business challenges and identify data-driven solutions
Understand how management, marketing, HR, finance, and global business concepts connect to support overall organizational strategy
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
